invariants.rule: official resolution failure must-not read bundled Guru
invariants.positive_case: explicit SourceUnavailable and bundled access counter remains zero
invariants.negative_case: bundled fixture is returned after official source failure

invariants.rule: workflow/spec must-not use one homogeneous path rule
invariants.positive_case: workflow resolves one Markdown file while spec resolves an ordered directory tree
invariants.negative_case: spec is treated as a Markdown file or workflow path is recursively expanded

invariants.rule: resolved path must-not escape dedicated root
invariants.positive_case: fenced repository-relative path resolves under guru-template root
invariants.negative_case: absolute, parent traversal, or symlink escape leaves the dedicated root

invariants.rule: official E2E must use exact `@mindfoldhq/trellis@0.6.7` binary and a path-consistent dedicated source root
invariants.positive_case: package/version/binary realpath and dedicated source-root assertions pass for all four stacks
invariants.negative_case: current fork or monorepo-root path mismatch produces a green install

invariants.rule: official E2E source must use a hermetic HTTPS smart Git remote whose unique advertised ref resolves to the current candidate before invocation
invariants.positive_case: local CA, smart HTTP log, ls-remote tag and recloned content digest all match current commit
invariants.negative_case: file/local source, unadvertised tag, reused old remote/ref or stale content proves release
